source: class DetachedBag { public List<Item?> Items=[]; }
class Item { public int V=0; }

class Bag { public Item Anchor=new Item(); public List<Item?> Items=[]; public List<int?> Nums=[]; public List<List<int>?> Nested=[]; public bool HasNull() { return Items.Contains(null); } public int NullIndex() { return Items.IndexOf(null); } public void RemoveNull() { Items.Remove(null); } }
class Probe {

public static bool DerivedContainsNull() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(new Item()); b.Items.Add(null); List<Item?> a=b.Items.Where((Item? item) => true); return a.Contains(null) && a.IndexOf(null)==1; }

public static bool StoredNestedNull() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Nested.Add([1]); b.Nested.Add(null); bool ok=b.Nested.Contains(null) && b.Nested.IndexOf(null)==1; b.Nested.Remove(null); return ok && b.Nested.Count==1 && !b.Nested.Contains(null); }

public static bool InsertNullFirst() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(new Item()); b.Items.Insert(0, null); bool ok=b.Items.IndexOf(null)==0; b.Items.Remove(null); return ok && b.Items.Count==1 && b.Items[0]!=null; }
public static bool DetachedContains() { DetachedBag b=new DetachedBag(); b.Items.Add(null); return b.Items.Contains(null) && b.Items.IndexOf(null)==0; }
public static bool DetachedRemove() { DetachedBag b=new DetachedBag(); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Remove(null); return b.Items.Count==0; }
public static bool LocalNull() { List<Item?> a=[null]; return a.Contains(null) && a.IndexOf(null)==0; }
public static bool StoredContains() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(null); return b.Items.Contains(null); }
public static bool StoredIndex() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(new Item()); b.Items.Add(null); return b.Items.IndexOf(null)==1; }
public static bool StoredRemove() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Remove(null); return b.Items.Count==0; }

public static bool RemoveFirstNull() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Add(new Item() { V=7 }); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Remove(null); return b.Items.Count==2 && b.Items[0]!.V==7 && b.Items.IndexOf(null)==1; }

public static bool RemoveUntilEmpty() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Remove(null); b.Items.Remove(null); return b.Items.Count==0 && !b.Items.Contains(null) && b.Items.IndexOf(null)==-1; }
public static bool NullMiss() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(new Item()); b.Items.Remove(null); return b.Items.Count==1 && !b.Items.Contains(null) && b.Items.IndexOf(null)==-1; }
public static bool Empty() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Remove(null); return !b.Items.Contains(null) && b.Items.IndexOf(null)==-1; }

public static bool NonNullIdentity() { Bag b=new Bag(); Item item=new Item(); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Add(item); return b.Items.Contains(item) && b.Items.IndexOf(item)==1 && !b.Items.Contains(new Item()); }

public static bool RemoveIdentity() { Bag b=new Bag(); Item item=new Item(); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Add(item); b.Items.Remove(new Item()); b.Items.Remove(item); return b.Items.Count==1 && b.Items[0]==null; }
public static bool ReplaceNull() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items[0]=new Item(); return !b.Items.Contains(null) && b.Items.IndexOf(null)==-1; }

public static bool DerivedList() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(null); b.Items.Add(new Item()); List<Item?> a=b.Items.Where((Item? item) => true); a.Remove(null); return a.Count==1 && b.Items.Count==2 && b.Items.Contains(null); }
public static bool NullableNumbers() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Nums.Add(null); b.Nums.Add(1); b.Nums.Remove(null); return b.Nums.Count==1 && !b.Nums.Contains(null); }
public static bool NestedListNull() { List<List<int>?> a=[null,[1]]; return a.Contains(null) && a.IndexOf(null)==0; }
public static Bag CreateBag() { Bag b=new Bag(); b.Items.Add(new Item() { V=7 }); b.Items.Add(null); return b; }
